evals.name: redis-cache-adapter
evals.prompt: Implement a caching repository adapter using github.com/redis/go-redis/v9.
evals.expected_output: Redis adapter with Get, Set with TTL, and JSON marshaling.
assertions: Serializes domain structs to bytes/JSON with expiration TTL.
Handles redis.Nil error and translates to domain cache miss.

evals.name: distributed-lock-lua
evals.prompt: Implement a distributed lock in Redis with TTL and safe atomic release via Lua script.
evals.expected_output: Lock acquisition with SetNX and atomic unlock checking token ownership using Lua script.
assertions: Uses SetNX with unique lock token and TTL.
Releases lock via atomic Lua script checking token equality before delete.
Prevents unlocking someone else's lock if TTL expired during processing.

evals.name: redis-pipeline-batch
evals.prompt: Fetch 50 user cache keys in a single network round-trip from Redis.
evals.expected_output: Batch operation using redis.Pipeline or MGet.
assertions: Executes all commands in a single network round trip.
Parses individual command results and handles missing keys gracefully.
